analysis.primaryGoal: Drive purchases of discounted products during summer sale
analysis.audience: Retailers and business customers of Westpack looking for jewelry boxes, displays, or accessories
analysis.offer: Up to 50% discount on selected jewelry boxes, displays, and accessories

layoutPatterns: Top-down scroll, from hero to offer to product grid
Sectioned color backgrounds with clear separation
visualStyle.imageStyle: 3D illustrated product mascots with sunglasses in a summer/beach scene. Product shots integrated in a faux-beach setting with playful graphics.

reusablePatterns: Mascot-style product illustrations for seasonal storytelling
Large, bold discount text or badges on images
Single clear primary CTA in colored box
Adding urgency with phrases like 'first come, first served'
Display of multiple product categories in a single campaign
risks: Heavily promotional tone may not suit all brand messaging
Some visuals may require localization for non-summer or international audiences
Lack of visible subject/preheader may impact email open if not well configured elsewhere

confidence.notes: Not all CTAs or headline elements are repeated in every language version. Some fine legal print faint but readable.
